title: Carried launcher full gates are never settled or expired after the gated-control removal; overflow and restart lines tell agents to rerun finished gates
outcome: A carried launcher full gate leaves the session's carried checks once it is terminal, gone, missing or past its TTL, and no agent is told to rerun a gate that ended normally.
acceptance: In production, a carried launcher gate (ends_by_report=false) is retired when its poll sees it terminal, launcher_gone or run_missing, or past the restored TTL, without waiting for the ENGRAM_CARRIED_CHECK_LIMIT overflow or a restart.
The overflow and restart paths emit no 'Run the gate again' line for a gate that had already ended; engram_has_open_check no longer counts finished carried gates.
Behavioural tests cover: a finished gate retired without overflow; a fifth launch after four finished gates emits no rerun line; a restart after a finished gate emits no lost-to-restart line.
